personal.title: Personal agents

budgets.description: Daily limits on AI usage per organisation, person or agent. The day is the UTC day. Once a limit is reached, a run ends before its next model call; a call in flight is never cut, so a limit can be passed by one call.
budgets.currencyNote: A currency limit counts only calls with a stored price, and stops only those. Calls without a price count toward the token limit alone. Where several budgets apply, the tightest wins.
budgets.empty: No budget set yet. Without a budget, usage is not limited.

budgets.unpricedCalls_other: {{count}} calls without a price (count toward tokens only)

budgets.agentsNeedRight: Agents can be picked by those who manage agents. Existing agent budgets can still be changed and removed in the list.
budgets.tokensHint: Input and output together. Empty: no token limit.
budgets.costHint: Counts only calls with a stored price. Empty: no currency limit.

errors.cost: An amount in euros, for example 5 or 2.50.

sources.title: Read:
sources.hidden_one: {{count}} source is not visible to you.
sources.hidden_other: {{count}} sources are not visible to you.

personalMark.title: Personal: for you alone
personalMark.text: This message holds what you read through your own access, or it came about in a conversation that held it. It stays with you: while such a message is in the history the agent is given, it puts anything it wants to write elsewhere to you for release first. With “Start afresh” at the top of your conversation alone with the agent you draw a line: after it the agent gets nothing from before (no history, no hits from earlier runs), and the mark ends for new runs. What you released for it to remember stays.

freshStart.title: Start afresh?
freshStart.text: From now on {{agent}} gets nothing in this conversation of what came before: no history from before this point, and neither reading the conversation nor searching its earlier runs (from other conversations too) finds anything from before. What you released for it to remember stays in its memory. The “Personal” mark ends with it for new runs. Work {{agent}} is doing in this conversation is cancelled; a notice shows it. The messages stay visible to you.
freshStart.markerText: {{agent}} gets nothing more of what is above: not in its history, not by reading the conversation, not by searching earlier runs. What you released for it to remember stays.
